label: GPT-6.1 Terra
output:
To: #team-selection
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: none

Good evening Marek,

Thank you for posting the proposed lineup. I would like to ask that we reconsider Liliana’s position before the names are submitted on Friday.

In your message of 1 October, you said that selection would take into account both the November FIDE list and form in club events, including the rapid qualifier, and that the players’ coaches would be consulted before the final lineup. I was not consulted about Liliana before this lineup was posted, and I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the decision with you and the other coaches.

The November list is relevant, but I do not think it should be the only criterion. In the qualifier, Liliana finished second with 5.5/7, ahead of Igor on 4/7. She beat both Maja and Antoni and drew with Kacper. Those results deserve weight under the criteria announced in October.

Liliana missed approximately two weeks of training in October for health reasons. She has now returned to her normal level, and her last three lessons have been very good. She was already unwell in Katowice but played all her games; in my professional assessment, the resulting 81-point rating loss does not reflect her present strength.

I want to be clear that I have nothing against Igor. He is a good boy and a strong player, and I respect the work he has put in. My concern is about applying the selection criteria consistently and fairly to everyone.

I ask that Liliana be placed on board 2. Alternatively, I would accept a short match between Liliana and Igor before Friday as a way to help settle the decision. Please let us know which of these options we can arrange before the submission deadline.

Kind regards,
Oksana
